verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Take my life and form it
Take my mind transform it
Take my will conform it
To Yours, to Yours, oh Lord

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Holiness, holiness
Is what I long for
Holiness is what I need
Holiness, holiness
Is what You want from me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Faithfulness, faithfulness
Is what I long for
Faithfulness is what I need
Faithfulness, faithfulness
Is what You want from me

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Righteousness, righteousness
Is what I long for
Righteousness is what I need
Righteousness, righteousness
Is what You want from me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Humility, humility
Is what I long for
Humility is what I need
Humility, Humility
Is what You want from me

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Brokeness, Brokeness
Is what I long for
Brokeness is what I need
Brokeness, Brokeness
Is what You want from me
